projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
End-to-end analytics dashboard that ingests customer CSV files and application log files, processes and models that data, and serves it through visualization components. Scope covers three data domains: (1) customer CSV ingestion and normalization, (2) application log parsing and analysis, (3) dashboard visualization and UI components. Goal is a milestone-driven delivery where every work item is small enough to execute independently.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization, csv, logs

tasks.name: M1: Data Foundation & Customer CSV Ingestion
tasks.details: Milestone 1. Establish the storage/warehouse layer and build a reliable ingestion path for customer CSV files: schema definition, upload/landing mechanism, parsing and validation, deduplication, and loading into the analytics store. Exit criteria: customer CSV files land, validate, and are queryable in a normalized customer table.

tasks.name: M2: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Milestone 2. Build the log ingestion and analysis path: define the log event model, parse raw application log lines into structured events, handle malformed lines and multi-line stack traces, derive analysis metrics (error rates, latency distributions, top failure signatures), and expose those metrics as queryable aggregates. Exit criteria: raw application logs become structured events plus a metrics set the dashboard can consume.

tasks.name: M3: Visualization Components & Dashboard UI
tasks.details: Milestone 3. Deliver the user-facing dashboard: shared layout and navigation, reusable chart component library, and the customer plus log-analysis dashboard screens wired to the query layer. Exit criteria: a user can open the dashboard and view populated customer and log visualizations with working filters.

tasks.name: M4: Integration, Performance & Launch Readiness
tasks.details: Milestone 4. Tie the pipeline and UI together for production: end-to-end scheduled runs, query performance and caching, observability for pipeline failures, documentation and runbook, and user acceptance sign-off. Exit criteria: automated refresh runs unattended, dashboards meet load-time targets, and the team has a documented runbook.

tasks.name: Provision analytics store and dev environment
tasks.details: Stand up the analytics database/warehouse instance, create dev and staging schemas, add connection config and secrets handling, and document local setup steps. Deliverable: a repeatable environment bootstrap that any team member can run.

tasks.name: Define customer CSV schema contract and column mapping
tasks.details: Document the expected customer CSV contract (required vs optional columns, types, date/currency formats, allowable nulls) and map each source column to the target customer table. Include a written data dictionary and a canonical sample file.

tasks.name: Build CSV file landing and upload endpoint
tasks.details: Implement the inbound path for customer CSV files: an upload endpoint plus a watched landing directory, with file naming convention, size limits, and archival of the raw original file for audit. Deliverable: a file arrives and is recorded as an ingestion run.

tasks.name: Implement CSV parser for encoding and delimiter edge cases
tasks.details: Parse customer CSVs robustly: UTF-8 with BOM, quoted fields containing commas and newlines, alternate delimiters (comma vs semicolon), header aliasing, and consistent type coercion of dates/numbers. Deliverable: parser function with unit tests over tricky fixtures.

tasks.name: Add row-level validation with reject report
tasks.details: Validate each parsed row against the schema contract (required fields, type checks, email/phone format, date ranges). Quarantine invalid rows and produce a per-run reject report listing row number, column, and reason. Deliverable: valid rows proceed, invalid rows are explainable and never silently dropped.

tasks.name: Implement deduplication and customer identity resolution
tasks.details: Define the customer natural key, detect duplicate rows within a file and across files, and choose a merge/upsert rule for conflicting attributes (most recent wins). Deliverable: rerunning the same file does not create duplicate customers.

tasks.name: Load normalized customers into analytics store
tasks.details: Create the normalized customer table(s) and write the load step that upserts validated, deduplicated rows with ingestion metadata (source file, run id, loaded_at). Deliverable: a query returns customer records with lineage back to the source file.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion test suite with fixture files
tasks.details: Assemble a fixture library covering happy path, malformed rows, duplicate customers, encoding issues, and very large files. Wire them into automated tests for parse, validate, dedupe, and load. Deliverable: CI-runnable test suite with documented expected outcomes.

tasks.name: Define structured log event schema and severity taxonomy
tasks.details: Specify the normalized log event fields (timestamp, level, service, request id, user/customer id, message, latency, status code) and map raw severity labels (WARN/WARNING/ERROR/FATAL etc.) into a standard taxonomy. Deliverable: written event schema plus target table definition.

tasks.name: Build log file collection and rotation handling
tasks.details: Collect application log files from the source location, handle rotated files (app.log.1, .gz archives), track which byte offsets/files were already consumed, and skip incomplete trailing lines. Deliverable: repeat collection runs do not reprocess or lose log lines.

tasks.name: Implement line parser for standard application log format
tasks.details: Write the parser that turns a single log line into a structured event: timestamp formats and timezones, bracketed level tokens, logger name, and the free-text message. Support both plain-text and JSON-formatted log lines if both appear in the corpus. Deliverable: parser plus unit tests per format.

tasks.name: Handle multi-line stack traces and malformed lines
tasks.details: Detect continuation lines belonging to a preceding error event (stack traces, indented cause chains) and attach them to the parent event. Route unparseable lines to a quarantine stream with counts so they can be inspected without failing the run.

tasks.name: Extract request, latency, and status fields for performance metrics
tasks.details: Enrich parsed events with request identifiers, HTTP status codes, and latency values where available, joining related request start/end lines into a single request record. Deliverable: request-level records suitable for latency percentile calculations.

tasks.name: Compute error rate and top failure signature aggregates
tasks.details: Build aggregate tables: errors per hour per service, error rate against total volume, and top failure signatures produced by normalizing error messages (strip ids, timestamps, and variable data into a template). Deliverable: queryable aggregates refreshed per run.

tasks.name: Track log freshness and processing watermark
tasks.details: Persist a watermark of the last successfully processed log timestamp and file offset, expose a freshness indicator, and raise a flag when logs are stale beyond the expected interval. Deliverable: dashboard can show whether log data is current.

tasks.name: Build log parser test suite with sample log corpus
tasks.details: Create a sample log corpus covering clean lines, JSON lines, stack traces, malformed entries, and timezone variance. Wire into automated tests asserting event counts, field extraction, and quarantine behavior.

tasks.name: Scaffold dashboard app shell, routing, and theme
tasks.details: Create the frontend application skeleton: build tooling, routing between dashboard pages, shared layout with header/sidebar navigation, base theme tokens (colors, spacing, typography), and a placeholder page per planned screen.

tasks.name: Build shared dashboard data API client
tasks.details: Implement the typed client the UI uses to fetch customer metrics and log aggregates, including response typing, error handling, and a caching/refetch policy. Deliverable: one module all chart containers use instead of ad-hoc fetches.

tasks.name: Build chart primitive wrappers (line, bar, donut)
tasks.details: Wrap the chosen charting library into three reusable primitives with a consistent prop interface: line/trend, bar/comparison, and donut/share. Include axis formatting, tooltip, and legend conventions. Deliverable: documented components with a storybook or demo page.

tasks.name: Build sortable paginated data table component
tasks.details: Create a reusable table for drill-down lists (customer lists, top failing endpoints) with column sorting, pagination, number/date formatting, and CSV export of the current view.

tasks.name: Build customer analytics dashboard screen
tasks.details: Assemble the customer screen from the primitives: total and new customers, segment/cohort breakdown, acquisition trend, and top-customer table. Wire to the shared API client with KPI summary cards at the top.

tasks.name: Build log health and error analysis screen
tasks.details: Assemble the log screen: error rate over time, errors by severity and service, top failure signatures with counts, latency trend, and a data-freshness indicator. Wire to log aggregate endpoints.

tasks.name: Implement global filters (date range, segment, severity)
tasks.details: Add a shared filter bar with date-range presets plus custom range, customer segment selector, and severity filter for log views. Propagate filter state through the URL so views are shareable and survive refresh.

tasks.name: Add loading, empty, and error states plus responsive pass
tasks.details: Implement skeleton loaders, empty-state messaging (no data for filter), and per-widget error boundaries with retry. Then verify layouts at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths. Deliverable: no blank or broken panels under any data condition.

tasks.name: Orchestrate scheduled end-to-end refresh job
tasks.details: Chain the CSV ingestion, log processing, and aggregate refresh steps into one scheduled job with ordered stages, failure short-circuit, and per-stage status logging. Deliverable: a single scheduled run refreshes all dashboard data unattended.

tasks.name: Tune dashboard query performance and add caching
tasks.details: Profile the dashboard queries, add appropriate indexes and pre-aggregation, and introduce a short-TTL cache for expensive widgets. Set a target of sub-2-second initial dashboard load on representative data volume. Deliverable: before/after query timings.

tasks.name: Add pipeline observability, alerts, and dead-letter handling
tasks.details: Emit run metrics (duration, rows in/out, rejects, failures), add alerting on failed or stale runs, and implement a dead-letter location for files or batches that fail processing so they can be replayed. Deliverable: a failing run is visible and recoverable without manual log digging.

tasks.name: Set up data quality monitoring checks
tasks.details: Define automated expectations per dataset (row count thresholds, null-rate ceilings, duplicate-rate ceilings, freshness windows) and surface failures as run warnings. Deliverable: a quality report per run visible on a status page.

tasks.name: Write architecture docs and operations runbook
tasks.details: Document the pipeline architecture, data dictionary, metric definitions, deployment steps, and a runbook for common failures (bad CSV, stale logs, failed refresh) with replay instructions.

tasks.name: Run UAT with stakeholders and capture sign-off
tasks.details: Prepare a UAT script covering each dashboard screen and metric, run it with stakeholders on staging, log defects with severity, and record formal sign-off or the follow-up list.
